prompt:
Our team is debating whether to focus more on unit tests or integration tests for our microservices. We have limited time and resources. What are the trade-offs between these two testing levels? I need arguments for both sides so we can make an informed decision.

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The reply explains trade-offs between unit tests and integration tests for microservices.
The reply provides arguments supporting unit tests.
The reply provides arguments supporting integration tests.
The reply acknowledges the constraint of limited time and resources.
The reply stays focused on testing approaches without introducing unrelated topics.
